description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling OAuth2 authentication, including PKCE code generation, token refresh logic, state encoding/decoding, and OAuth2 client configuration schema within the Superset project.

classes.name: OAuth2StateSchema
classes.description: Marshmallow schema for serializing and deserializing OAuth2 state information.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientConfigSchema
classes.description: Marshmallow schema for OAuth2 client configuration parameters.

methods.name: generate_code_verifier
methods.description: Generates a high-entropy PKCE code verifier string.

methods.name: generate_code_challenge
methods.description: Generates a PKCE code challenge from a code verifier using SHA256 and base64 URL encoding.

methods.name: get_oauth2_access_token
methods.description: Retrieves a valid OAuth2 access token, refreshing if expired and possible.

methods.name: refresh_oauth2_token
methods.description: Refreshes the OAuth2 access token using the refresh token, with distributed locking.

methods.name: encode_oauth2_state
methods.description: Encodes OAuth2 state information into a JWT string with expiration.

methods.name: decode_oauth2_state
methods.description: Decodes a JWT string back into OAuth2 state information.

methods.name: check_for_oauth2
methods.description: Context manager that runs code and initiates OAuth2 dance if needed based on exceptions.
